sources.note: Only catalogue metadata readable; files need ELAR login. Abom items are a photocopied 2016 elicitation wordlist, a lexical database and elicitation audio; the 'Phonology Sketch Draft' is described as a rough phonological sketch of Bitur (Abom only a collection-level language tag). No Abom prosodic statement visible in metadata.
